A post that addresses people by handle.

Thanks @alice for spotting that, and @bob for the fix.

Case does not matter: @alice is the same person, and the link uses the canonical spelling.

A handle nobody has stays as text: @nobody-at-all.

An address is not a mention: write to someone@example.org instead.

Mentions inside code are text: @alice and

@alice

Mentions inside a quotation are text, because quoting someone is repeating their words rather than addressing the people they addressed:

Post #12

I agree with @alice about this.

But a mention outside it still resolves: @bob.
